'''Erelut''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Private/Legends|Private]] who served in the [[First Battalion]] of the [[Fifth Infantry]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. His unit was led by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Piloc]].<ref name="TOR" />
